dayConvention: Day numbering: the first day with impressions is day 1, and the first N days are days 1 to N. Stage bands: 1-3, 4-7, 8-14, 15-30, 31+. A learning reset restarts the count at day 1 on the reset date. All in the account timezone.
note: Moshi launched 2026-10-02, so today is day 5. The Moshi campaign has a Sales objective but its ad set optimizes for CONVERSATIONS.
dataSource: The tree is get_ad_account_tree (references/meta-reads.md). Both ad sets optimize for CONVERSATIONS, so both campaigns map to engagement although their objective is OUTCOME_SALES. T1, T3 and T4 carry the expected ads_over_max_ads flag, which stays out of flags[].
